preconditions: The corresponding accepted source is clean landed canonical main. Exact Core/control wheel inputs are staged for the registered bootstrap action. All physical registered node queues must be idle and known before the shared source update; an unavailable SSH endpoint does not prove idle. No public GitHub/push, active task termination, lock deletion or environment repair is authorized.
instruction: Execute the separately registered bootstrap action first. If it succeeds, run E:/conda_package/envs/gnn/python.exe -B scripts/syncmate/install.py apply --node gpu4090. The script selects its verified immutable controller runtime and a reachable coordinator, holds all physical node queue admission gates, updates the single shared checkout once, verifies online peers, activates the exact deployment and records offline peers as deferred. A returning peer may install only this approved staged Core/control pair before accepting a task. Do not run the former global Core installer.
readBack: Run E:/conda_package/envs/gnn/python.exe -B scripts/syncmate/install.py deployment-status and the source CLI dependencies command. Verify this landed target and exact Core/control pins. Independently read the online node receipts via install.py receipt --node <online-node>. Offline nodes must remain deferred and are not counted as verified or live-boot-tested; do not require powering them on. Immutable runtime/deployment storage is persistent product state; installation attempt logs under .workblock/runtime/install are temporary. Closeout archives necessary evidence and cleans only superseded attempts/credentials when no longer needed. Retain failed attempts, maintenance markers and original locks for diagnosis. No experiment launch is part of this action.
